detail.summary: Security should respond to real risk: protect administration and sensitive data without creating unnecessary friction for visitors.

Add CAPTCHA or rate limits only when there is an abuse vector.
Secrets and private content should never live in the public repository.

features.label: AI

researchConcepts.label: Truth as Being
researchConcepts.summary: Output quality is not the same as truth.
researchConcepts.detail: The research line separates being from its representations. An answer can be useful, fluent, or convincing, but it gains strength only when it remains accountable to what it claims to represent.

researchConcepts.label: Fidelity
researchConcepts.summary: Not every representation carries the same weight.
researchConcepts.detail: Fidelity is not measured by beauty, authority, or immediate utility, but by the effective relation between representation, experience, and contrast with being.

researchConcepts.label: Meaning
researchConcepts.summary: Meaning does not live inside the sign.
researchConcepts.detail: A representation means something when a system can reconstruct what the representation does not contain by itself. This separates language processing from understanding.

researchConcepts.label: Own Purpose
researchConcepts.summary: Goal-directed behavior is not enough for owned direction.
researchConcepts.detail: The central question for agents and AI is not only what they do, but where their direction comes from: prompt, reward, external mission, or internal appropriation.

flow.label: BEING
flow.description: Separate reality, manifestation, and narrative.

flow.label: REPRESENT
flow.description: Measure fidelity, trace, and mediation.

flow.label: MEAN
flow.description: Explain reconstruction and experiential injection.

flow.label: DIRECT
flow.description: Evaluate borrowed purpose, agency, and simulation.

detail.title: Philosophical system
detail.summary: The research works as a design criterion for AI: separating output from truth, representation from reality, meaning from processing, and agency from borrowed purpose.
points: Truth as Being: an output matters only if it remains accountable to reality.
Representation fidelity: not every useful answer represents well what it claims to represent.
Own purpose: the question is not whether behavior is directed, but where direction comes from.
